chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī. And Ibn Abī ʿUmayr also narrated it from Abī al-Miʿzā, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:

Regarding a man who kills a slave by mistake, he said: "He must free a slave, fast two consecutive months, and give charity to sixty needy persons." He said: "If he is unable to provide the slave, then fasting is upon him; and if he is unable to fast, then charity is upon him."

key_terms.سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا: sixty needy persons who are to receive the charity
key_terms.عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ: the freeing of a slave as an expiation
key_terms.لَمْ يَقْدِرْ: is unable; lacks the capacity to perform

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for accidentally killing a slave in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the legal ruling for one who accidentally kills a slave, listing expiatory duties of freeing a slave, fasting two consecutive months, and feeding sixty needy persons. It also states an order of substitution when one is unable to fulfill the earlier obligation, making it a significant text in the fiqh of diyat and kaffarah.
